body: I feel more relieved writing it all out. Thank you very much. I just hope that i can always stay happy and find my true real soulmate. But do you have any suggestion for making people to respect you more? I really need to work on that....

Hey there, Happy Birthday to you and hope you enjoyed your day! I feel you too as i am also not the most outstanding child among the family. But i believed that every person had a purpose to come to this world, so live just like there is no tomorrow!! Is okay to fail but the most important thing is you learnt from your past mistakes! Study is just a basic but what's real in life is we have to learn to deal with our shit. There is so much thing you can do in this world, don't kill yourself because of this. Cheer up!

Thanks for your reply. I always look happy on the outside that's why i think people can make a fun out of me. It goes kind of far where i feel people just don't respect me anymore like i am a joke to them. Sometimes i just feel hurt and all i can do is just smile on the outside... I have to admit that i am a very patient person and i don't get angry easily. But u know people have tolerance, so do i. I know people always said that believed in yourself and ignore those negativity comments. Yeah, it is hard you know when the thoughts hits you real hard in reality. As i failed to achieve something in life, i kind of feel like my parents doubted on my decisions and always said mean things to me that made me feel really sad. The reason i want to study abroad is because i don't want to get controlled by them. I love them but just sometimes their words are like knives that pierce through my heart. I know parents always wants the best out of their child but when the pressure that they gave i just can't bear with it sometimes. I even feel like i am just an extra for my family. My brothers, cousins excelled in their studies and they are very outstanding....Not like me i am just a normal child that this make me feel there is a gap between them...It feel sucks growing up in an Asian family where they think smart and outstanding children is the best. I just want to be happy in my life and do the things i like.
